title: a grappling hook
description: a normal grappling hook using geokolib
body:
Grappling Hooks  

Add fast, fluid movement to your world with a fully synchronized grappling hook system.  

Grappling Hooks introduces a new grappling hook item that can be fired at blocks and surfaces to pull players through the air. The mod features server-authoritative physics and multiplayer synchronization, ensuring smooth and consistent gameplay in both singleplayer and multiplayer worlds.  

Features  
🪝 Fire a grappling hook projectile  
🎯 Attach to blocks and surfaces  
🚀 Pull yourself toward the hook point  
🌐 Fully synchronized multiplayer support  
⚡ Server-authoritative movement physics  
🎨 Custom models, textures, and animations  
🔧 Lightweight Fabric mod  
Requirements  
Minecraft (supported version)  
Fabric Loader  
Fabric API  
GeckoLib  
License  

MIT License  

About  

Whether you're exploring caves, scaling mountains, or traveling across your world, Grappling Hooks provides a fun and immersive mobility tool that makes movement faster and more exciting.
